quickstop: A person walks forward at a normal brisk pace and stops in one step, both feet together, standing still.
quickstop2: A person walks briskly forward, then stops quickly with a short step and stands relaxed.
startturnL: A person standing still turns to the left and starts walking forward in the new direction in one smooth motion.
startturnR: A person standing still turns to the right and starts walking forward in the new direction in one smooth motion.
turnback: A person standing still turns around to face behind and walks away at a normal pace.
walkstopturn: A person walks forward, stops and turns ninety degrees to the right to face a wall, then stands still.
startwalk: A person standing relaxed starts walking forward at a normal brisk pace.
walkstopgrab: A person walks forward to a ladder, stops in front of it and grabs a rung with both hands at chest height.
stepoff: A person standing at the top of a ladder steps forward onto the floor and walks away at a normal pace.
